406.saw: Telegram form addressed 'S. Maj.te la Reine de Portugal, a/bord du yacht Amelia, Naples', stamped URGENZA / Naples; body is 5-digit numeric code groups (about 6 lines visible, e.g. 80272 32840 65354), signed Hintze Ribeiro. No decode on the page. Portuguese/French service text.

499.frame: StAbt Tuerkei I 5-4-5, image 1 of 8 (Ferducci, Ragusa 24 Mar 1542)
